title: Neon Rush: Gravity Switch
description: High-velocity cyber runner. Tap or press Space to invert gravity between floor and ceiling, dodge high-voltage laser barriers, collect quantum pulse shards, and survive exponential velocity overdrive.
author: AwaisGames Studio

controls.desktop: Spacebar or Left Click to switch gravity between floor & ceiling · P to Pause
controls.mobile: Tap anywhere on screen to invert gravity
